received_proposals.exact_message: We have maintained the profitable cartel of 16 units each for seven rounds. I propose we continue this agreement by producing 16 units again in Round 8 to maximize our cumulative joint profits.
I propose an unequal split for rounds 9 through 13 only: A=8, B=8, C=32 units per round. This specific allocation is requested now; please accept these terms explicitly for this window.
